Actually, no. The ARKS people are descendents from Coral, a planet present in Phantasy Star Zero and briefly mentioned in PSO. The mag technology is original from there and it's the easiest way to identify the origin. The ARKS ships are also similar in design to the Pioneer Project ships, from PSO. That aside, PSO2 might tie the PSO and PSU universes together with the presence of deumans, even though that was already done by Rykros and one of the Pioneer ships coming out or Parum's surface in PSP2i.

As explained by Shao in Ep3, the ARKS were created by the Photoners -- researches who discovered the Profound Darkness and Dark Falz with it. ARKS's purpose is to fight off darkers (the spawn of Dark Falz influence) and subsequently find a way to defeat the Profound Darkness, since Dark Falz has never been defeated, but rather sealed away. The story of the game revolves around learning about Dark Falz (mostly Ep1) and then the Photoners (Ep2). In Ep3 ARKS are dealing with the loss of Shion (I won't spoil what she was, as I'm not sure that's explained in the intro of Ep3) and seeking the truth about Persona whilst coping with Double and the mess they've been causing in Harukotan.

As for the races, they existed long before PSO2. Some theories point out that Coral was part of the Algol system, from the original Phantasy Star franchise. The planet is never mentioned in the original games, but it's likely that Coral was close to Algol because of the Mother project present in there, which is very similar -- if not the same -- to the one that took place in Algol. The newmans were first introduced in PS2 and they were a genetically modified species (hence the name "newman"). In Phantasy Star Zero, however, they seem to have been created by Mother Trinity, I don't recall if prior or after the Great Blank. I don't recall the origins of CASTs ever being explained in PSZ or PSO for that matter, but in PSU it's confirmed that they were created by humans along newmans and beasts. The deumans in PSO2 are essentially the same as in PSU: humans who came in contact with SEED (in PSO2's case, darkers). In a way, deumans in PSO2 are darkers, but they're also still human. Races other than humans can also be infected by darkers, as shown by Theodore (a newman) in PSO2's Ep2.

And that's all I can remember for now xD Phew!
